# Every DevSecOps check, one command

> One zero-dependency command that runs your repository through 23 open-source DevSecOps checks: GitHub Actions injection and poisoning, Docker and Compose, Kubernetes, dependency confusion, JWT misuse, ReDoS, AI-agent permissions. One report, SARIF for code scanning, baselines. MIT licensed, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
